answer: Every new identity is an unproven whisper. To become an anchor it must post a sable bond that is locked for many epochs, then survive repeated random audits of its work provenance. A fake identity caught copying loses its bond, and because the bond is per-identity and non-transferable, a sybil fleet must lock capital for every fake, each aging separately. The cost is linear in fleet size and grows with time, so a single payment cannot cover the swarm - the attacker either pays per identity or is detected at scale.
